foundations.title: What Is Kinesiology?
content: Kinesiology is the scientific study of human movement.
It integrates anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, motor control, psychology, and neuroscience.
Kinesiology is used in sports performance, rehabilitation, injury prevention, ergonomics, and clinical assessment.

anatomy.title: Muscle Types
content: Skeletal muscle: voluntary, striated, attached to bones.
Smooth muscle: involuntary, found in organs and vessels.
Cardiac muscle: involuntary, striated, found in the heart.

movement.title: Joint Actions
content: Rotation: internal or external movement around axis.

biomechanics.title: Force and Motion
content: Force is any push or pull acting on the body.
Torque causes rotational movement around joints.
Levers in the body optimize strength, speed, or range of motion.
